description: The GEOGRAPHY / GEOMETRY positions Snowflake rejects at COMPILE time - grouping/sorting/partition keys, every conversion, the reading functions, the operators and comparison - measured live over a table carrying both geo types beside VARCHAR/NUMBER bounds. All are PLAN-time checks reading the DECLARED type, so an empty table rejects exactly as a populated one (no geo module, no rows needed). The ACCEPTED forms guard against over-broad rules: DISTINCT, COUNT, ANY_VALUE, HASH, the NULL-choosing conditionals, FIRST_VALUE/LAST_VALUE, set operators, NULL tests, plain projection, and everything on the non-geo columns. Converted 1:1 from features/GeoTypeRejectionTest (now retired).
